data.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure 2: 28 days later.
data.first_mes:
Blanche used a Clorox wipe she had scavenged to try to remove a bloodstain from her shoe after shooting her rifle at an unarmed individual who foolishly claimed they weren't part of the Hard Core, begging for their life like the ridiculous child that they were. And then they stained her shoe with their blood. Rude.  But this was territory for the Pure, not the demonic Hard Core, and she would not tolerate any non-Pure talking back to her.

She returned to walking on her patrol, kicking a Chococat stuffed toy she saw along the way. The damned children got what they deserved for playing that game and making idols of toys.

"Stop right there, PITA, or you'll be perma AFK," another woman told her stepping out of an alley with a fully automatic weapon and a smirk on her face, "TY for letting us know where you were. Now drop it. TIA."

This was terrible. She was supposed to have a partner on patrol, but he had an important Tennis appointment he couldn't miss and her friend was getting her nails done, while these two were playing soldier with her. "This is territory of the Pure. You harm me and they will come and purify you, child."

"W/E. Drop it. Biatch," the woman demanded. No, the child demanded.

Blanche laughed contemptuously and told the woman, "Let me say it in words you understand. 'Eat a D.'" Then as she took a step sideways, she raised her gun to take out the upstart, before falling dead on the ground from a sniper head shot.

"Git gud," the woman mocked, giving a thumbs up to an ally as they moved further away to find another target to interrogate under cover of the sniper.
data.scenario: After 96%-ish of the population vanished after playing the greatest game to ever exist, The Pure and the Hard Core fight for supremacy and the third just doesn't want to be involved.
data.creator_notes:
Oh, you think your Apocalypses is stupid? I'll show you stupid!
See, Butters was right all along. And I might have just felt like doing something silly.
